_comment: Known boards for board.py. No passwords here: board.py reads the SSH password from the PW (or PIPW) environment variable.
kind: 'service' = the launcher is installed and runs as the user service cyberdeckzero.service (systemctl --user; APPLaunch.service up to v0.6.0);
'desktop' = Raspberry Pi OS desktop (lightdm + labwc) owns the screen: the test launcher stops lightdm and test-stop starts it again;
install.sh installs the desktop variant there (cyberdeckzero-desktop.service, started from the applications menu, gives the desktop back on exit).
fb: the panel's framebuffer as the board reports it (width x height in buffer orientation, bpp, pixel format);
rotate: degrees counter-clockwise that turn a raw framebuffer capture into what the user sees (PIL Image.rotate).
test_env: the launcher environment of test-start (from cyberdeckzero.service, install.sh board profiles and the scratchpad test runs).
quirks: no_environ = an ssh command string containing the word 'environ' drops the connection (Pi 3A+): board.py refuses such a command.
pi3a and pi3a-dsi are the same Pi 3A+ (same host) with one panel or the other: pi3a = Luckfox 3.5in SPI (install.sh profile pi3a-luckfox35),
pi3a-dsi = Waveshare 4.3in DSI (profile pi3a-wsdsi43; the panel mounted since 2026-10-13). Use the entry of the panel that is mounted.
arch: the bundle the board takes (default arm64): fzm1 (Panasonic FZ-M1 mk2 tablet, x86_64, Armbian on Ubuntu 26.04, report 028) is amd64;
its test_env is install.sh's pc profile (pc-fzm1-2). Since 2026-10-22 it has Armbian's XFCE with lightdm and the desktop variant of install.sh: a desktop board.
dm (desktop boards, default lightdm): the display manager's unit without .service that test-start stops and test-stop starts again.
Flip a board to 'desktop' once it has a desktop AND install.sh ran again on it (it switches to the desktop variant: the user service
is removed, cyberdeckzero-desktop.service and the menu entry installed): set kind to 'desktop' (fzm1 with Armbian's XFCE: lightdm,
the default, so no dm needed). Back to 'service' when the desktop is removed and install.sh ran again.
